meta.title: TechToJob — Community for developers and tech companies in Spanish
meta.description: Join the Spanish-speaking tech community where developers, engineers and companies actually connect. Post your profile, join tournaments and find real opportunities.
meta.ogDescription: Developers and tech companies meet before a role even opens. Join the community.

hero.title: Stop sending CVs into the void.
hero.titleHighlight: Build things and let people find you.
hero.description: TechToJob is the community where developers, engineers and tech companies meet before a role even opens. You take part, you build, they find you.
hero.discordHint: FREE · NO CV · STRAIGHT TO THE GROUP

howItWorks.title: Your next opportunity comes from showing up, not from filling out forms.

steps.title: Join the server
steps.description: You join the Discord and introduce yourself. No long forms, no automated filters that discard you before a person reads you.

steps.title: Take part in the community
steps.description: You answer questions, share projects, join tournaments. People start to know you by what you do, not by your CV.

steps.title: Companies find you
steps.description: The companies in the community see how you work. When something comes up, they message you directly.

steps.title: You land a real opportunity
steps.description: No algorithm decides. It's a person who already knows who you are and what you bring.

talento.title: Let them find you.
talento.description: Post your profile with your stack, your level and what you're looking for. Companies in the community check it when they need someone like you. No automated filters throwing your CV away before a person reads it.

features.title: No filters turning you down
features.description: There's no algorithm deciding whether you get in. A human reads your profile.

features.title: You don't need to be senior
features.description: Juniors, mid-levels and seniors all fit. What matters is what you can do.

features.title: Free for you
features.description: Posting your profile costs nothing. Companies pay to access profiles, you don't.

features.title: They message you directly
features.description: If you fit the role, they reach out with no middlemen. No generic auto-reply email.

empresas.title: See people work before you hire them.
empresas.description: Post what you need and get access to real profiles from the community. Not just a CV: you see how they think, what they build and how they solve problems. Less screening, more context.

features.title: Profiles with real context
features.description: Not just their CV. You see their projects, how they take part and what others think.

features.title: Direct access to talent
features.description: No agencies filtering on their own. You decide who to contact.

features.title: Less time searching
features.description: The community already has active developers and engineers. You don't start from zero.

features.title: Post for free
features.description: Posting a job opening costs nothing. You only pay if you want wider profile access.

tournaments.title: Compete, build and get seen.
tournaments.description: Open challenges where you build something real, with a jury and public criteria. What gets won actually gets used. This very website came out of a tournament.

items.title: Tournament #2 · TechToJob landing
items.description: Design and build the official TechToJob website with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind. The landing you're looking at is the result.

items.title: Tournament #3 · Coming soon
items.description: Next community challenge. Categories and rules in the works.

items.title: Tournament #4 · To be confirmed
items.description: More challenges are coming. Each one with a winner who takes home more than a prize.

networking.title: The good jobs aren't found. They're heard about.
networking.description: Channels per area, people in the sector and questions answered in minutes. Jobs someone shares because they know the hiring manager. Some of the best jobs never even get posted.

items.title: Tournament #2 results · The new site is live
items.summary: More than 12 entries. The winning design is deployed and it's what you're looking at right now.

items.title: New specialist channels on the Discord
items.summary: We opened channels dedicated to data engineering, cybersecurity and software architecture.

items.title: How to land your first tech job with no experience
items.summary: An article with practical advice from community members who went through it.

newsletter.title: Jobs, tournaments and what's worth your time in the sector.
newsletter.description: Every Monday: new openings, tournaments starting and news from the community. One email a week, not one more.
newsletter.button: Send it to me on Mondays
newsletter.spamNotice: No spam. Unsubscribe in one click.

testimonials.title: They're already in. You could be next.

items.name: Laura Méndez
items.quote: I joined with nothing to show and a few months later a company messaged me about a project I'd posted on the server.

items.name: Diego Fuentes
items.quote: I stopped firing CVs into the void. Here people know me by how I work, not by a piece of paper.

items.name: Sofía Roldán
items.quote: I answered a question in a channel on a Sunday and a week later I was in a first interview.

items.name: Martín Quiroga
items.quote: The best place to get into the sector with no prior experience. It feels like a real community.

items.name: Carla Suárez
items.quote: We posted an opening and 48 hours later we had candidates who already knew us. Never going back to an agency.

closing.title: If you got this far, you already know what TechToJob is.
closing.description: It's not one more job board. It's a community where people get to know each other, build things together and opportunities show up on their own.

footer.brand: Community for developers and tech companies in Spanish.
